name: Curtis Burgess
bio:
Curtis Burgess, based in Ft. Collins, Colorado, is a highly skilled tattoo artist excelling in newschool and neotraditional styles. Drawing from an impressive following of approximately 72,000 on Instagram, his proficiency and passion are evident in the art he creates. Through his meticulous work at Tribal Rites, he has crafted a diverse portfolio that showcases his immersive understanding of various tattooing styles. With a focus on maintaining a high level of professionalism, Curtis accepts bookings through email to provide personalized service in an efficient manner.
